description: Change the DB pool size in an env file, keep the comment. DISTILL-CANARY-c40dab85

files.services/orders/.env.prod:
DB_HOST=pg-orders.internal
DB_POOL_SIZE=20      # per instance; max_connections is 400
DB_POOL_TIMEOUT=5
LOG_LEVEL=info
